header.name: Advanced Machine Learning
header.description: This is an advanced course in Machine Learning. It is intended for senior undergraduate and graduate students who already have background in PR or ML. The course is designed as a set of special topics that will be covered through (i) introductory lectues (ii) lectures covering selected recent research papers (iii) tutorials where the studens will code in-class using notebooks and libraries provided by the instructor and (iv) take-home programming assigments working in small groups using real-life data provided by the instructor. The course will focus on algorithms and deep-learning models along with providing a perspective of real-world applications and hands-on experience using data from selected use-cases.
prerequisites_desirable: Pattern Recognition or Machine Learning, Deep-learning (desirable but not mandatory)
Python, exposure to Pandas and/or Pytorch is desirable
prerequisites_desirable_resolved: Pattern Recognition or Machine Learning, Deep-learning (desirable but not mandatory)
Python, exposure to Pandas and/or Pytorch is desirable

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Understanding and implementing basic deep-learning models, training, evaluation and deployment procedures and architectures including use of GPUs.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Understanding noisy data, domain adaptation, uncalibrated models,and concept drift. Implementing conservative inference, calibration, metric-learning, meta-learning, and test-time adaptation

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Understanding transformers, language models, in-context learning, ULMFit and representation learning for NLP. Utilizing embeddings, vector indexing and ranking models to develop semantic search.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Understanding learning on relational data via inductive-logic programming, and neuro-symbolic techniques and applying these on chemical structures in the context of drug design.

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Recalling, and describing multi-modal models, diffusion models and foundation models in general.

lecture_topics: Introduction to Deep Learning for Tabular, Sequence, and Image Data

weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignment 1: Learning with noisy tabular data
Assignment 2: Handling concept Drift w/ evolving tabular data
Tutorial: Embeddings from scratch, BERT, Spectre, etc.
Tutorial: LLM from scratch, OpenAI GPTx API, Huggingface models
Tutorial: Relational learning on chemical structures of molecules

lecture_topics: Overview of topical topics not covered in the course
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Exposure to Muti-modal and Diffusion-based Generative Models
